name: valuation
description: Two-stage DCF valuation, started with /valuation {ticker}. Runs unattended: fetches statements, 10-Ks, earnings releases and call transcripts from EDGAR and the Motley Fool (set SEC_USER_AGENT to your name and email), makes every judgment call itself and flags each one on the page for review, and builds a tabbed HTML page and an Excel workbook with live formulas. If ~/repos/homepage exists, it also publishes the page there by committing only its own files and pushing.
